wafProbeResult: Sucuri Cloudproxy in passive/rule-selective mode. 10 consecutive no-delay GETs of /product.php all returned 200. SQLi/XSS/honeypot payloads trigger 403 (rule-selective, not crawl-path-blocking). No challenge interstitial; no captcha; no UA-block. Per Rule B10, hasWaf=false because the WAF does not block normal crawl traffic.

wafWorkaround.notes: Sucuri Cloudproxy is rule-selective only (SQLi/XSS/honeypot). Plain axios with default desktop UA returns 200 on all catalog GETs.
